title: making a mobile game with a team of AI agents. day 2: buying land
author: ILokasta
selftext:
hey! my new game is being built by 4 AI agents in parallel (claude code for the code, codex for 2D art, tripo for the 3D parts, all put together in godot)

the loop: drop a drill on a winch, grab ore, reel it up before it overheats, upgrade, dig deeper. in the clip you drag Pipo (the drill) to the edge of your plot, buy the next lot and dig there

my part is design, art direction and saying no a lot xD the agents do the rest

happy to answer anything about the workflow, and feedback on the game feel is very welcome
